join.title: Join as a remote guest
join.greenRoom: You're in the green room — the host is checking your camera and mic. You'll go on air shortly.
join.selfLabel: You — this is what the host receives.
join.hostSharing: The host is sharing their view.
join.fine: Nothing connects until you tap Join. Your camera and microphone travel directly to the host, peer to peer over WebRTC and encrypted in transit; only the connection handshake crosses a public signalling service. This page runs in your browser and uploads nothing else. The host can hear, seat, mute or remove you, and you are part of whatever they record or stream.
join.appLink: Open this invite in the app instead
footer.licence: Proprietary — All Rights Reserved. © Mike Weaver. Free to use today; future versions may be sold. Not open source.
footer.yours: What you record and stream is yours, and so is the responsibility for it. Freally Capture's author never receives, stores or relays any of it.
join.status.invited: You're invited. The invite is valid for about {{time}} — tap Join when you're ready.
join.status.expired: This invite has expired — ask the host for a new link.
join.status.missing: No invite in this link — open the exact link or QR code the host shared.
join.status.damaged: This invite looks damaged — ask the host to share the link again.
join.status.noReconnect: Couldn't reconnect — reload this page while your invite is still valid to rejoin.
join.status.reconnecting: Connection lost — reconnecting in {{seconds}} s (attempt {{attempt}} of {{max}})…
join.status.blocked: Camera or microphone blocked: {{error}} — allow access and tap Join again.
join.status.reconnectedMuted: Reconnected — your mic stays muted (you muted it).
join.status.removed: The host removed you — the link still works if you're invited back.
join.status.banned: The host removed you from this session.
join.status.iceFailed: The direct connection failed — both sides are behind strict NATs. The host can set up a TURN relay in their Remote dialog.
join.status.connected: Connected — sharing your camera and mic. Keep this page open.
join.status.signallingLost: Signalling lost — reconnecting (your picture and sound keep flowing)…
join.status.hostUnreachable: The host isn't reachable — are they still hosting?
join.status.sharing: Sharing your screen into the session.
